blurb: Captain Sean specializes in shark fishing trips for families, targeting species like Bull Sharks, Hammerheads, and Black Tip Sharks near the coast. He also offers deep sea trolling and bottom fishing up to 15 miles offshore for various fish species, as well as inshore fishing trips along the Halifax River and Intracoastal Waterway. Specialty charters include sightseeing trips and seasonal shrimping and crabbing.
